card.name: Start of a unit after a dose number
card.fires_on: The first piece of a measurement unit right after a number, such as G in 4 Gb/s, K in 128 Kbps, or meg in 1024 megabytes. It also fires on the space before mcg/day.

modes.label: Data rate and size units
modes.description: Prefix letters like G, M, K, ter, meg or kil after a number in computing speeds and storage sizes.
modes.example: capable of data rates to 4<< G>>b/s at 60 GHz.

modes.label: Dose or rate units
modes.description: The gap or digit just before a small drug amount unit such as mcg/day or mL.
modes.example: released in vivo at a rate of approximately<< >>20 mcg/day.

card.writes: It suppresses weight words like kilograms and weight, steering the model away from mass units after a number.
card.plain: It spots the start of a unit like Gb/s or megabytes after a number and pushes away from weight words.
